steps.en: A weekly summary report is produced
steps.why_en: Only a daily report exists; no weekly one.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada laporan harian; tidak ada yang mingguan.

steps.en: A monthly summary report is produced
steps.why_id: Tidak ada laporan classified vehicle bulanan.

steps.en: A summary report with totals, outstanding and settled counts exists
steps.id: Ada laporan ringkasan dengan jumlah total, outstanding, dan settled
steps.why_en: It covers all notices of all time, not one week or month.
steps.why_id: Isinya semua notice sepanjang waktu, bukan satu minggu atau satu bulan.

steps.en: The report lists offence, car park, amount, suspension reason and payment state
steps.id: Laporan memuat offence, car park, jumlah, alasan suspend, dan status bayar
steps.why_en: Offence shows as a code, and outstanding or settled is guessed from the amount, not the payment status.
steps.why_id: Offence berupa kode, dan outstanding atau settled ditebak dari jumlah, bukan dari status bayar.

steps.en: Reports reach the OIC dashboard for follow-up
steps.id: Laporan masuk ke dashboard OIC untuk tindak lanjut
steps.why_en: Reports are only emailed; no dashboard exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Laporan hanya dikirim lewat email; tidak ada dashboard di sistem.

steps.en: The report really reaches the OIC mailboxes
steps.id: Laporan benar-benar sampai ke kotak email OIC
steps.why_en: Email sending is switched off in the production settings, so by the repo it would not go out.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman email dimatikan di pengaturan produksi, jadi menurut repo tidak akan terkirim.
